scientific_limitations: Only the polarized split quadric over the two-element field and bidegree (2,3), not arbitrary genus-two curves or other finite fields.

Numerical classifications depend on exact reproducible exhaustive symbolic and finite group calculations.
Bibliographic priority remains subject to possible unindexed equivalent enumerations; no independent outside audit.
title: Complete maximal smooth genus-two nets on the binary split quadric
